Lemma
[Covariant differentiability of the convolution series] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0259 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-convolution-series-derivatives 1. ch23:23.24\group Convolution

Under the same hypotheses, the series of covariant $m$-tensors \[ \sum _{k\ge 1}\partial _t^\ell abla _x^m(\Box _xP_N)^{*k} \] converges uniformly on $\mathcal M^2 imes [0,T]$ and equals $\partial _t^\ell abla _x^mG_N$.
Proof

\sketch In a finite atlas, covariant derivatives are linear combinations of coordinate derivatives with smooth bounded coefficients, so Lemma 2 applies.

□
